dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about the Academy...

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: I'm no bard. If you want to hear stories, I suggest you hear them at the Podvorye Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: I can only tell you what sort of place this is. This was once a club for the nobility, which only fae and the children of high-ranking military officers could enroll in.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: Only when Her Majesty took the throne did it start to have a quota for enrolling commoners. That said, prejudice and discrimination have proved tough to break down.

dialogues.speaker: Lukyana
dialogues.text: Even now, we still get some noble whelps, far too big for their britches, who need to be taught the meaning of "egalitarian discipline" from the comfort of solitary confinement.
